items.title: Security Updates Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code.
